entries.title: Spell-dust and the bed
entries.literal_meaning: Provisional rendering: casting spell-dust, someone lifted someone from the sleeping bed and took them away.
entries.explanation: The line places removal from a bed beside the casting of spell-dust. The dictionary quotes it under a bed’s use for sleeping. Our reading follows that sudden disturbance of a resting place, while leaving both participants unnamed. It does not supply their relationship, intentions or consent, or establish that a spell caused an actual event.
entries.meaning_odia: ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ଶେଯରୁ ଉଠେଇ ନେବା ସହ ମନ୍ତର ଧୁଳି ପକାଇବାକୁ ରଖେ। ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଏହା ଶୋଇବା ପାଇଁ ବ୍ୟବହୃତ ଶେଯ ଅର୍ଥ ତଳେ ଅଛି। ଆମ ପାଠ ବିଶ୍ରାମସ୍ଥଳର ଏହି ହଠାତ୍ ବଦଳକୁ ଦେଖେ। କିଏ କାହାକୁ ନେଲା ତାହା ଅକୁହା, ତେଣୁ ପାଠଟି ସମ୍ଭାବ୍ୟ। ସମ୍ପର୍କ, ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ ବା ସମ୍ମତି ଦିଆଯାଇନାହିଁ; ମନ୍ତରରେ ସତରେ ଘଟଣା ଘଟିଲା ବୋଲି ପ୍ରମାଣ ନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading preserves an unexplained disturbance without completing its story.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠ ଅବୁଝା ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନକୁ ରଖେ, କାହାଣୀର ଖାଲି ଜାଗା ପୂରାଏନାହିଁ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ପାଠକମାନେ ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ପଢ଼ି ବକ୍ତା ନ କହିଥିବା କଥାଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଚିହ୍ନାଇଲେ। ସେମାନେ ନିଜର କଳ୍ପିତ ଶେଷକୁ ଉତ୍ସର କଥା ଭାବେ ଲେଖିଲେ ନାହିଁ। / Readers distinguish the line from endings they might imagine. This discussion is invented.
entries.cultural_context: Adjective sense2 concerns sleeping-use; the earlier verb gloss “he slept” does not assign gender here. No romance, abduction, ritual procedure or magical efficacy is established.

entries.title: Praise that turns to revulsion
entries.literal_meaning: Extraordinary beauty; seeing you makes me feel like vomiting.
entries.explanation: The apparent praise turns sharply into rejection. The dictionary places the saying under figurative revulsion, separate from its physical sense. Our reading hears an insulting reversal, not a reliable description of someone’s appearance. A speaker’s disgust does not establish another person’s worth, and the line supplies no relationship or occasion.
entries.meaning_odia: ପ୍ରଶଂସା ପରି ଶୁଣାଯାଉଥିବା କଥା ହଠାତ୍ ଘୃଣାରେ ବଦଳିଯାଏ। ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ଶାରୀରିକ ବାନ୍ତି ନୁହେଁ, ଲକ୍ଷଣାର୍ଥରେ ଘୃଣାବୋଧ ତଳେ ଅଛି। ଆମ ପାଠ ଏଠି ଅପମାନର ସ୍ୱର ଶୁଣେ, କାହାର ରୂପର ନିର୍ଭରଯୋଗ୍ୟ ବର୍ଣ୍ଣନା ନୁହେଁ। ବକ୍ତାଙ୍କ ଘୃଣା କାହାର ମୂଲ୍ୟ ନିର୍ଣ୍ଣୟ କରେନାହିଁ। ସମ୍ପର୍କ ବା ଅବସର ଅକୁହା।
entries.english_summary: Our reading questions praise used to deliver an insult.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠ ପ୍ରଶଂସା ଆଢ଼ୁଆଳରେ ଅପମାନକୁ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ କରେ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ପାଠଚକ୍ରରେ ଜଣେ କହିଲେ, କଥାର ଆରମ୍ଭ ଭଲ ଶୁଣାଗଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଶେଷଟି କାହାକୁ କଷ୍ଟ ଦେଇପାରେ। / A reading group discusses how a flattering opening can become hurtful. This discussion is invented.
entries.cultural_context: The earlier Krishna Singh Mahabharata example illustrates the physical sense; it does not supply this saying’s author. Irony is our reading of the contrast, not a medical or beauty judgment.

entries.odia: ଭାତ ଥିଲେ ଭାତୁଆ ଅପୂର୍ବ?
entries.title: Rice and the people who serve
entries.literal_meaning: If there is rice, are people serving for food hard to find?
entries.explanation: The question connects available food with the availability of a servant. The dictionary supplies both serving-for-food and servant senses. Our critical reading asks what is lost when a person’s labour is reduced to a meal. The wording does not establish that workers are plentiful everywhere, that food is adequate payment, or that anyone owes service for being fed.
entries.meaning_odia: ପ୍ରଶ୍ନଟି ଭାତ ଥିବା ସହ ସେବା କରିବା ଲୋକ ମିଳିବାକୁ ଯୋଡ଼େ। ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଅନ୍ନ ପାଇଁ ସେବା କରୁଥିବା ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି ଓ ଚାକର ଅର୍ଥ ଅଛି। ଆମ ସମାଲୋଚନାମୂଳକ ପାଠ ପଚାରେ: ଜଣଙ୍କ ଶ୍ରମକୁ କେବଳ ଭୋଜନରେ ମାପିଲେ କଣ ଅଦେଖା ରହେ? ସବୁଠି କର୍ମୀ ସହଜରେ ମିଳନ୍ତି, ଭୋଜନ ଯଥେଷ୍ଟ ପାରିଶ୍ରମିକ, କିମ୍ବା ଖାଇଥିବାରୁ ସେବା ଦେବାକୁ ହେବ—ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ଏସବୁର ପ୍ରମାଣ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our response distinguishes feeding someone from valuing their work.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା ଖାଇବାକୁ ଦେବା ଓ ଶ୍ରମର ମୂଲ୍ୟ ଦେବାକୁ ଅଲଗା କରେ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ଏକ ଆୟୋଜନରେ ଖାଦ୍ୟ ବ୍ୟବସ୍ଥା ହେବା ପରେ ଦଳଟି କର୍ମୀଙ୍କ କାମ, ସମୟ ଓ ପାରିଶ୍ରମିକ ନେଇ ଅଲଗା ଆଲୋଚନା କଲା। / Organizers discuss workers’ time and pay separately from catering. This scene is invented.
entries.cultural_context: This critical response is editorial, not a traditional counter-moral. The source question provides no verified employment custom, universal worker trait or justification of servitude.

entries.title: Inside, and at the door
entries.literal_meaning: You went inside and left us guarding the door.
entries.explanation: The speaker contrasts someone’s entry with the task assigned to those left at the doorway. The dictionary defines setting another person to guard the entrance. Our reading asks how participation and responsibility have been divided. The line does not establish deception, betrayal or an unfair intention; it makes the different positions audible without explaining why they arose.
entries.meaning_odia: ଜଣେ ଭିତରକୁ ଯିବା ଓ ଅନ୍ୟକୁ ଦୁଆର ଜଗାଇବା କଥା ବକ୍ତା ପାଖାପାଖି ରଖନ୍ତି। ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଅନ୍ୟ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିକୁ ପ୍ରବେଶଦ୍ୱାର ରକ୍ଷା ପାଇଁ ରଖାଇବା ଅର୍ଥ ଅଛି। ଆମ ପାଠ ପଚାରେ, ଅଂଶଗ୍ରହଣ ଓ ଦାୟିତ୍ୱ କିପରି ବଣ୍ଟା ହେଲା? ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ଠକାମି, ବିଶ୍ୱାସଘାତ ବା ଅନ୍ୟାୟ ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ ପ୍ରମାଣ କରେନାହିଁ। ଭିନ୍ନ ସ୍ଥାନ ଜଣାଯାଏ, କାରଣ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading notices a division of roles without inventing its motive.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠ ଭୂମିକାର ବଣ୍ଟନ ଦେଖେ, ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ ଗଢ଼େନାହିଁ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ସଭା ଆରମ୍ଭରୁ ଦଳଟି ପାଳିକରି ସ୍ୱାଗତକାମ କରିବାକୁ ଠିକ୍ କଲା, ଯାହାଫଳରେ ସମସ୍ତେ ଆଲୋଚନାରେ ବସିପାରିବେ। / A group rotates welcoming duties so everyone can join a discussion. This arrangement is invented.
entries.cultural_context: The domestic verb gloss describes an assignment, not a verified incident or universal rule. The speaker’s and addressee’s gender and relationship are not supplied.

entries.odia: ତାକୁ ଭାତ ମକମକଉଛି, ନାଁ ବୟସ ମକମକଉଛି?
entries.title: Rice, or age?
entries.literal_meaning: Is rice making that person impudent, or is age doing it?
entries.explanation: The question offers two explanations for conduct the speaker regards as impudent. That meaning comes from the dictionary’s third sense. Our critical reading pauses before accepting either explanation: a question can carry a judgment without proving its cause. Neither eating rice nor belonging to an age group establishes how someone behaves.

entries.literal_meaning: Stopping someone’s food and cutting off their head are called the same thing.
entries.explanation: The dictionary places the saying under stopping someone’s food. Its stark comparison gives deprivation the force of a threat to life. Our reading treats that equivalence as rhetorical emphasis on food’s importance, not a clinical equation or an instruction to injure anyone. The line does not identify who withholds food or describe an actual incident.
entries.meaning_odia: ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ଖାଦ୍ୟ ବନ୍ଦ କରିବା ଅର୍ଥ ତଳେ ଅଛି। ତୀବ୍ର ତୁଳନାଟି ଖାଦ୍ୟରୁ ବଞ୍ଚିତ କରିବାକୁ ଜୀବନ ପ୍ରତି ବିପଦ ପରି ଦେଖାଏ। ଆମ ପାଠ ଏହାକୁ ଖାଦ୍ୟର ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱ ଉପରେ ଜୋର ବୋଲି ବୁଝେ, ଚିକିତ୍ସାଗତ ସମାନତା ବା କାହାକୁ ଆଘାତ ଦେବା ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦେଶ ନୁହେଁ। କିଏ ଖାଦ୍ୟ ବନ୍ଦ କଲା ବା ସତରେ କଣ ଘଟିଲା, କୁହାଯାଇନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading takes the food-deprivation warning seriously without literalizing its violence.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠ ଖାଦ୍ୟରୁ ବଞ୍ଚନାର ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱ ଦେଖେ, ହିଂସାକୁ ଆକ୍ଷରିକ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦେଶ କରେନାହିଁ।

entries.title: A hundred utterances, one writing
entries.literal_meaning: Provisional reading: a hundred utterances, one written record.
entries.explanation: The source places this compact fragment under matter committed to writing. Our reading understands the contrasting term as spoken utterances, but the head does not separately gloss it. The numbers set many beside one; no verb supplies a precise equation or legal rule. We read an invitation to consider what writing preserves, not proof that every written statement is true.
entries.meaning_odia: ଲିଖିତ ବିଷୟ ଅର୍ଥ ତଳେ ଉତ୍ସ ଏହି ଛୋଟ ଖଣ୍ଡଟି ରଖେ। ଭାକାକୁ ମୁହଁର କଥା ଭାବେ ନେଇ ଆମେ ସମ୍ଭାବ୍ୟ ପାଠ ଦେଉଛୁ; ଏହି ଶବ୍ଦର ଅଲଗା ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ଏଠି ନାହିଁ। ସଂଖ୍ୟା ଅନେକ ପାଖରେ ଗୋଟିଏକୁ ରଖେ, କିନ୍ତୁ କ୍ରିୟା ନଥିବାରୁ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ସମୀକରଣ ବା ଆଇନର ନିୟମ ମିଳେନାହିଁ। ଆମ ପାଠ ଲେଖା କଣ ରଖିପାରେ ଭାବେ, ସବୁ ଲେଖା ସତ ବୋଲି ମାନେନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our provisional reading compares speech and writing without inventing a full rule.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ସମ୍ଭାବ୍ୟ ପାଠ କଥା ଓ ଲେଖାକୁ ତୁଳନା କରେ, ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ନିୟମ ଗଢ଼େନାହିଁ।

entries.title: Coming and going alone
entries.literal_meaning: You came alone and will go alone; the family will not go with you.
entries.explanation: The repeated solitude stands against the family named in the final phrase. The dictionary gives family members, including children, as the relevant sense. Our reading hears a reflection on mortality and the limits of accompaniment. That interpretation does not make family affection worthless, require withdrawal from loved ones, or prove a doctrine about what follows death.
entries.meaning_odia: ପୁଣିପୁଣି ଆସୁଥିବା ଏକାପଣ ପାଖରେ ଶେଷ ଖଣ୍ଡ ପରିବାରକୁ ରଖେ। ଅଭିଧାନରେ ପିଲାମାନଙ୍କ ସହ ପରିବାରସ୍ଥ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି ଅର୍ଥ ଅଛି। ଆମ ପାଠ ଏଠି ମୃତ୍ୟୁ ଓ ସାଙ୍ଗରେ ରହିପାରିବାର ସୀମା ନେଇ ଭାବନା ଶୁଣେ। ଏହା ଆମ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା; ପରିବାରର ସ୍ନେହ ମୂଲ୍ୟହୀନ ବୋଲି ନୁହେଁ। ପ୍ରିୟଜନଙ୍କୁ ଛାଡ଼ି ରହିବା ବା ମୃତ୍ୟୁ ପରେ କଣ ହୁଏ ସେବିଷୟରେ ନିଶ୍ଚିତ ମତ ମଧ୍ୟ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading holds life’s limits beside the value of present companionship.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠ ଜୀବନର ସୀମା ସହ ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନର ସାଙ୍ଗତ୍ୟର ମୂଲ୍ୟ ରଖେ।

entries.cultural_context: Arrival and departure are the quoted images; mortality is our interpretive frame. The later Fakirmohan example illustrates another sense and does not identify the saying’s author.

entries.title: The father rides; the son, a little
entries.literal_meaning: Whose father rides a horse, that son rides a little.
entries.explanation: The rhyme moves from a father’s riding to a smaller amount in the son’s clause. The dictionary quotes it under “slightly; a little.” Our reading notices the partial echo between generations, without turning it into a law of inheritance. The line does not explain how either person learned, measure their skill, or establish that every child repeats a parent’s occupation.
entries.meaning_odia: ବାପଙ୍କ ଘୋଡ଼ା ଚଢ଼ିବାରୁ ପୁଅଙ୍କ ଖଣ୍ଡରେ ଅଳ୍ପ ପରିମାଣକୁ ଛନ୍ଦ ଯାଏ। ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଏହା ସାମାନ୍ୟରେ ବା ଈଷତ ଅର୍ଥ ତଳେ ଅଛି। ଆମ ପାଠ ପିଢ଼ି ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଆଂଶିକ ପ୍ରତିଧ୍ୱନି ଦେଖେ, ବଂଶଗତ ନିୟମ ନୁହେଁ। କିଏ କିପରି ଶିଖିଲେ, କାହାର ଦକ୍ଷତା କେତେ, ବା ସବୁ ପିଲା ବାପମାଆଙ୍କ ପେଶା ନିଅନ୍ତି କି ନାହିଁ—ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ତାହା ପ୍ରମାଣ କରେନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading hears a small repetition, not an inherited destiny.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠ ଅଳ୍ପ ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତି ଶୁଣେ, ବଂଶଗତ ଭାଗ୍ୟ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ବାପଙ୍କ ସହ କାମ ଦେଖିଥିବା ପୁଅଟି ନିଜେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଛୋଟ କାମ ଶିଖିଲା। ତାଙ୍କ ଅନ୍ୟ ପସନ୍ଦକୁ ମଧ୍ୟ ପରିବାର ସ୍ଥାନ ଦେଲା। / A child learns one small task while retaining other interests. This scene is invented.
entries.cultural_context: The quotation’s father and son remain intact, without an added biological or caste claim. The earlier Radhanath Darbar verse illustrates a different sense and is not this saying’s authorship.

entries.title: Neither doing it nor making way
entries.literal_meaning: Provisional reading: that person neither shits nor makes way.
entries.explanation: The blunt bodily image pairs not doing something with not letting another pass. The dictionary supplies making room for another as the relevant sense of leaving the way. Our reading applies the contrast to obstruction: someone neither proceeds nor clears space. This does not identify a real person’s health, intention or circumstances, and it is not advice about bodily functions.
entries.meaning_odia: ରୁକ୍ଷ ଶାରୀରିକ ଚିତ୍ରଟି ନିଜେ ନ କରିବା ସହ ଅନ୍ୟକୁ ବାଟ ନ ଛାଡ଼ିବାକୁ ଯୋଡ଼େ। ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଅନ୍ୟକୁ ଯିବାକୁ ଜାଗା ଦେବା ଅର୍ଥ ଅଛି। ଉତ୍ସର ହଗ ଶବ୍ଦରୂପ ଅବିକଳ ରଖି ଆମେ ଏହାର ସମ୍ଭାବ୍ୟ ପାଠ ଦେଉଛୁ। ଆମ ପ୍ରୟୋଗରେ କେହି ନିଜେ ଆଗେଇନାହାନ୍ତି କି ଜାଗା ମଧ୍ୟ ଛାଡ଼ୁନାହାନ୍ତି। ଏଥିରୁ ପ୍ରକୃତ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଙ୍କ ସ୍ୱାସ୍ଥ୍ୟ, ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ ବା ପରିସ୍ଥିତି ନିର୍ଣ୍ଣୟ ହୁଏନାହିଁ। ଏହା ଶରୀର ସମ୍ବନ୍ଧୀୟ ପରାମର୍ଶ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading describes obstruction while keeping the coarse register visible.

entries.title: Still tying the turban as court closes
entries.literal_meaning: While tying the turban, the court closes.
entries.explanation: The repeated tying phrase keeps preparation in progress while the court closes. The dictionary places the line under an office or court stopping work, not dismissal from a job. Our reading notices an opportunity ending before preparation finishes. The line does not say why the person took time, identify their role, or establish a particular court schedule.
entries.meaning_odia: ପାଗ ବାନ୍ଧିବା ଚାଲିଥିବା ବେଳେ କଚିରି ବନ୍ଦ ହୁଏ। ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଧାଡ଼ିଟି କଚିରିର କାମ ବନ୍ଦ ହେବା ଅର୍ଥ ତଳେ ଅଛି, ଚାକିରିରୁ ବାହାରିବା ଅର୍ଥରେ ନୁହେଁ। ଆମ ପାଠରେ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତି ସରିବା ଆଗରୁ ସୁଯୋଗ ସରିଯାଏ। କାହିଁକି ସମୟ ଲାଗିଲା, ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଙ୍କ ପଦ କଣ ବା କଚିରିର ସମୟସୂଚୀ କିପରି—ଉତ୍ସ ତାହା କହେନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading contrasts unfinished preparation with a closing opportunity.

entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ଜଣେ ଫର୍ମଟି ସଜାଉଥିବା ବେଳେ ଆବେଦନ ସମୟ ସରିଗଲା। ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ଥର ପାଇଁ ସେ ଆଗୁଆ ତାରିଖ ଲେଖିରଖିଲେ। / Someone misses an application deadline while arranging the form, then plans ahead for the next one. This scene is invented.

entries.title: Naming the rain amid the flood
entries.literal_meaning: The house is flooded, the water knee-deep; the one-eyed person says it is raining in torrents.
entries.explanation: The house and knee-deep water show a consequence; the speaker names the rain. The dictionary explicitly glosses torrential rain, not a light shower. Our reading asks whether naming an event is enough when its effects need attention. We reject using the quoted disability label to explain anyone’s judgment: the line supplies no evidence that impaired sight causes such a response.
entries.meaning_odia: ଘର ବୁଡ଼ି ପାଣି ଆଣ୍ଠୁଏ; ବକ୍ତା ବର୍ଷାର କଥା କହୁଛନ୍ତି। ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଦୁଲୁକିବା ଅର୍ଥ ପ୍ରବଳ ବର୍ଷା, ଅଳ୍ପ ବର୍ଷା ନୁହେଁ। ଆମ ପାଠ ପଚାରେ: ପ୍ରଭାବକୁ ଦେଖି କାମ କରିବା ଦରକାର ବେଳେ ଘଟଣାର ନାମ କହିବା ଯଥେଷ୍ଟ କି? ଉତ୍ସର ଦୃଷ୍ଟିସମ୍ବନ୍ଧୀୟ ତାଚ୍ଛଲ୍ୟକୁ ଆମେ ବିଚାରଶକ୍ତିର ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ଭାବେ ଗ୍ରହଣ କରୁନାହୁଁ। ଏପରି ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟାର କାରଣ ଦୃଷ୍ଟିବାଧା ବୋଲି ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ପ୍ରମାଣ କରେନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading attends to consequences without endorsing the disability taunt.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠ ପ୍ରଭାବକୁ ଦେଖେ, ଦୃଷ୍ଟିବାଧା ସମ୍ବନ୍ଧୀୟ ତାଚ୍ଛଲ୍ୟକୁ ସମର୍ଥନ କରେନାହିଁ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ଛାତରୁ ପାଣି ଝରୁଥିଲା। କେବଳ ବର୍ଷାର କଥା ନ କହି ଦଳଟି ଭିଜୁଥିବା କାଗଜକୁ ଶୁଖିଲା ସ୍ଥାନକୁ ନେଲା। / A group moves papers away from a leak instead of merely describing the rain. This response is invented.
entries.cultural_context: The critical response is editorial, not a supplied traditional counter-moral. No actual flood, medical assessment or disability-group trait is documented; other senses concern vibration and fear.

entries.title: We know why you keep passing
entries.literal_meaning: We know what you are moving back and forth for.
entries.explanation: The speaker claims to know the purpose behind someone’s repeated passing. The dictionary places the line under movement to and fro, not its later sense of delaying work. Our reading hears a knowing challenge, while leaving open whether the claimed knowledge is correct. The line identifies neither the purpose nor the relationship; it does not establish deceit, romance or wrongdoing.
entries.meaning_odia: କାହାର ବାରମ୍ବାର ଯିବାଆସିବା ପଛର କାରଣ ଜାଣିଛୁ ବୋଲି ବକ୍ତା କହୁଛନ୍ତି। ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ଯିବାଆସିବା ଅର୍ଥ ତଳେ ଅଛି, ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ କାମରେ ବିଳମ୍ବ ଅର୍ଥରେ ନୁହେଁ। ଆମ ପାଠରେ ବକ୍ତା ଜାଣିଥିବାର ଭଙ୍ଗୀରେ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ଉଠାଉଛନ୍ତି। ସେ ପ୍ରକୃତରେ ଠିକ୍ ଜାଣନ୍ତି କି ନାହିଁ, ତାହା ଖୋଲା ରହେ। ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ ବା ସମ୍ପର୍କ ଅଜଣା; ଠକାମି, ପ୍ରେମ ବା ଅପରାଧ ଏଥିରୁ ପ୍ରମାଣିତ ହୁଏନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: The speaker claims insight; our reading leaves that claim unproved.
entries.odia_summary: ବକ୍ତା ଜାଣିବାର ଦାବି କରନ୍ତି; ଆମ ପାଠ ତାକୁ ପ୍ରମାଣ ମାନେନାହିଁ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ଟେବୁଲ୍ ପାଖେ ବାରମ୍ବାର ଆସୁଥିବା ସାଥୀଙ୍କୁ ଜଣେ ପଚାରିଲେ, କିଛି ଦରକାର କି? ଅନୁମାନରେ ଅଟକି ନ ରହି ସେ ଉତ୍ତର ଶୁଣିଲେ। / Someone asks a repeatedly passing colleague what they need and listens instead of relying on a guess. This response is invented.
entries.cultural_context: The invented response asks rather than asserts knowledge; it is an editorial alternative, not a recorded traditional use. No gender, fixed social setting or hidden motive is supplied.

entries.title: The dragging is what hurts
entries.literal_meaning: Being taken by a tiger does not hurt; the dragging hurts.
entries.explanation: The line sets being taken by a tiger beside the discomfort of being dragged. The dictionary quotes it under dragging along the ground. Our reading hears an exaggerated complaint that singles out one part of a larger ordeal. It does not measure pain or establish that the larger danger is harmless; no actual encounter or speaker is identified.
entries.meaning_odia: ବାଘ ନେବା ସହ ଭୂମିରେ ଘୋଷାରି ନେବାର କଷ୍ଟକୁ ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ରଖେ। ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଏହା ଭୂମିରେ ଟାଣିନେବା ଅର୍ଥ ତଳେ ଅଛି। ଆମ ପାଠରେ ବଡ଼ ଦୁର୍ଦ୍ଦଶାର ଗୋଟିଏ ଅଂଶକୁ ବାଛି ଅତିଶୟୋକ୍ତିରେ ଅଭିଯୋଗ କରାଯାଏ। ଏହା ଯନ୍ତ୍ରଣାର ମାପ ନୁହେଁ ବା ବଡ଼ ବିପଦ ନିରାପଦ ବୋଲି ପ୍ରମାଣ ନୁହେଁ। ପ୍ରକୃତ ଘଟଣା ବା ବକ୍ତା ଚିହ୍ନଟ ହୋଇନାହାନ୍ତି।
entries.english_summary: Our reading singles out one discomfort within an exaggerated ordeal.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠରେ ଅତିଶୟ ଦୁର୍ଦ୍ଦଶା ଭିତରୁ ଗୋଟିଏ କଷ୍ଟ ଅଭିଯୋଗର କେନ୍ଦ୍ର।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ଲମ୍ବା ଯାତ୍ରାର ସବୁ ଅସୁବିଧା ମଧ୍ୟରୁ ଭଙ୍ଗା ବ୍ୟାଗ୍ ଟାଣିବା କଥାଟି ଜଣେ ବାରମ୍ବାର କହିଲେ। / A traveller keeps returning to the broken bag amid a difficult journey. This comparison is invented.
entries.cultural_context: Exact fused ବାଘନବା remains unchanged. The quoted contrast is rhetorical, not medical or wildlife advice. Later road and laziness senses do not supply this saying’s meaning.

entries.title: One keeps; another will squander
entries.literal_meaning: The books say: one will squander; one is keeping.
entries.explanation: The saying invokes books while putting keeping beside future squandering. The dictionary’s following explanation describes one person laboriously saving wealth and another later wasting it. Our reading notices the contrast between their actions. No particular book is named or independently checked, and the line does not establish a universal family pattern or identify an heir.
entries.meaning_odia: ବହିର କଥା ଉଠାଇ ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ରଖିବା ସହ ଉଡ଼ାଇବାକୁ ଯୋଡ଼େ। ଅଭିଧାନର ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟାରେ ଜଣେ କଷ୍ଟରେ ଧନ ସଞ୍ଚନ୍ତି, ପରେ ଅନ୍ୟ ଜଣେ ତାହା ଅପବ୍ୟୟ କରନ୍ତି। ଆମ ପାଠ ଏହି ଦୁଇ କାମର ବିରୋଧକୁ ଦେଖେ। କେଉଁ ବହି, ଉତ୍ସ ନାମ କହେନାହିଁ; ସ୍ୱତନ୍ତ୍ର ଯାଞ୍ଚ ମଧ୍ୟ ହୋଇନାହିଁ। ଏହା ସବୁ ପରିବାରର ନିୟମ ନୁହେଁ ବା କୌଣସି ଉତ୍ତରାଧିକାରୀଙ୍କ ପରିଚୟ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading contrasts saving and waste, without verifying a scripture.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠ ସଞ୍ଚୟ ଓ ଅପବ୍ୟୟର ବିରୋଧ ଦେଖେ, ଶାସ୍ତ୍ର ପ୍ରମାଣ କରେନାହିଁ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ଦଳଟି ଅନେକ ମାସ ଧରି ଜମାଇଥିବା ଟଙ୍କା ଅନାବଶ୍ୟକ ସଜାରେ ଖର୍ଚ୍ଚ ହେଲା। ପରେ ସମସ୍ତେ ଖର୍ଚ୍ଚର ଯୋଜନା ମିଳିତ ଭାବେ କଲେ। / A group revisits spending decisions after savings go on unnecessary decoration. This scene is invented.
entries.cultural_context: The ancient-books assertion belongs to the dictionary and quoted voice, not verified textual history. Exact tense contrast is retained; there is no financial recommendation or prescribed relationship.

entries.title: Let the visits continue
entries.literal_meaning: Let the coming and going continue; let there be no hope of a handful of rice.
entries.explanation: The line wishes for continued visits while setting aside an expectation of rice. Its dictionary placement concerns frequenting a place. Our reading values contact beyond what a visit might provide. That application is editorial: the source names no particular friendship, household or exchange, and it does not require a hungry guest to deny their needs.
entries.meaning_odia: ଯିବାଆସିବା ଚାଲିଥାଉ, କିନ୍ତୁ ମୁଠିଏ ଭାତର ଆଶା ନ ଥାଉ—ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ଏହି ଇଚ୍ଛା କହେ। ଅଭିଧାନରେ ବାରମ୍ବାର କୌଣସି ସ୍ଥାନକୁ ଯିବା ଅର୍ଥ ଅଛି। ଆମ ପାଠ ପ୍ରାପ୍ତିର ଆଶାଠାରୁ ସମ୍ପର୍କକୁ ଅଲଗା କରି ଦେଖେ। ଏହା ଆମ ପ୍ରୟୋଗ; ଉତ୍ସ କୌଣସି ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ବନ୍ଧୁତା, ପରିବାର ବା ଦେଣନେଣ କହେନାହିଁ। ଭୋକିଲା ଅତିଥି ନିଜ ଆବଶ୍ୟକତା ଲୁଚାଇବାକୁ ବାଧ୍ୟ ବୋଲି ଅର୍ଥ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading separates continued contact from an expected material return.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠରେ ଯିବାଆସିବା ଓ ପ୍ରାପ୍ତିର ଆଶା ଅଲଗା ରହେ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ଦୁଇ ବନ୍ଧୁ କିଛି ଦେବାନେବା ନ ଥିଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଦେଖା କରୁଥିଲେ। ଦରକାର ପଡ଼ିଲେ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କଥା ମଧ୍ୟ ଖୋଲାଖୋଲି କହୁଥିଲେ। / Two friends keep meeting and can also speak honestly about needing help. This scene is invented.
entries.cultural_context: The earlier Fakirmohan Galpaswalpa passage illustrates coming and going separately; it is not this saying’s authorship. No fixed hospitality custom, denial of food or duty is established.

entries.title: Six ears and a disclosed secret
entries.literal_meaning: Six ears, disclosure of the secret.
entries.explanation: The dictionary explains six ears as three people: a matter known to two reaches a third. The short saying compresses that disclosure into a phrase. Our reading notices how adding a listener changes the circle of knowledge. It does not prove that every third person spreads a secret or forbid seeking appropriate help about something troubling.
entries.meaning_odia: ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଛଅଟି କାନ ଅର୍ଥ ତିନି ଜଣ: ଦୁଇ ଜଣଙ୍କ ଗୁପ୍ତ କଥା ତୃତୀୟ ଜଣ ଜାଣନ୍ତି। ଛୋଟ ଢଗଟି ସେହି ପ୍ରକାଶକୁ ଧରେ। ଆମ ପାଠରେ ଆଉ ଜଣେ ଶୁଣିଲେ ଜାଣିଥିବା ଲୋକଙ୍କ ପରିସର ବଦଳେ। ସବୁ ତୃତୀୟ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି କଥା ପ୍ରଚାର କରନ୍ତି ବୋଲି ଏହା ପ୍ରମାଣ ନୁହେଁ। ଚିନ୍ତାଜନକ ବିଷୟରେ ଉପଯୁକ୍ତ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ ମାଗିବାକୁ ମଧ୍ୟ ଏହା ବାରଣ କରେନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading tracks a wider circle, not inevitable betrayal.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠରେ ଜାଣିବାର ପରିସର ବଢ଼େ, ବିଶ୍ୱାସଘାତ ଅନିବାର୍ଯ୍ୟ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ଦୁଇ ଜଣଙ୍କ ଯୋଜନା ଆଉ ଜଣଙ୍କୁ କହିବା ଆଗରୁ ସେମାନେ କଣ ଭାଗ କରିବେ ଠିକ୍ କଲେ। / Two collaborators agree what to share before inviting another into their planning. This example is invented.

entries.title: A question about complexion
entries.literal_meaning: Dark woman, does applying lime make you fair?
entries.explanation: The question places a woman’s dark complexion beside an applied white substance. The dictionary quotes it under the domestic word for woman, not its earlier magical or divine senses. Our critical reading asks why fairness should be a measure of worth at all. That response is editorial: the source supplies the taunt, not a stated challenge to colour prejudice.

Our reading hears a complaint about a connection’s painful cost, while leaving those roles open. It neither reconstructs a romance nor justifies punishment.

entries.title: While the jar held ghee
entries.literal_meaning: As long as there was ghee in the jar, Sajani’s body looked beautiful.
entries.explanation: The line places admired appearance beside a supply of ghee. It does not explain who admired her or why. Our editorial reading questions regard that lasts only while something desirable is available. That is an interpretation of the conditional praise, not proof that food changed her body or that a particular partner was selfish.

entries.explanation: The dictionary places this rhyme under the age of thirteen. Repeating “entered” makes the new age and bodily strength arrive together in the saying. Our reading hears an emphatic image of growing up, not a timetable for everyone’s development. The separate year-number prediction below belongs to another labelled genre.
entries.meaning_odia: ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଏହି ଧାଡ଼ି ତେର ବର୍ଷ ବୟସ ଅର୍ଥ ତଳେ ଅଛି। ପଶିଲା ପଦର ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତିରେ ନୂଆ ବୟସ ଓ ଦେହର ଶକ୍ତି ଏକାଠି ଆସନ୍ତି। ଆମ ପାଠରେ ଏହା ବଢ଼ିବାର ଜୋରଦାର ଚିତ୍ର; ସମସ୍ତଙ୍କ ବିକାଶର ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ସମୟସୂଚୀ ନୁହେଁ। ତଳେ ଥିବା ସନ ସମ୍ପର୍କୀୟ ଭବିଷ୍ୟବାଣୀ ଅଲଗା ନାମିତ ଶ୍ରେଣୀର।
entries.english_summary: A rhythmic age-and-strength claim, not a universal developmental rule.
entries.odia_summary: ବୟସ ଓ ଶକ୍ତିକୁ ଯୋଡ଼ୁଥିବା ଛନ୍ଦମୟ କଥା, ସାର୍ବଜନୀନ ବିକାଶ ନିୟମ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ଜନ୍ମଦିନରେ ଜଣେ କିଶୋର ନୂଆ କାମ ଶିଖିବାକୁ ଚାହିଁଲେ। ଶିକ୍ଷକ ତାଙ୍କ ସୁବିଧା ଅନୁସାରେ ଅଭ୍ୟାସ ବାଛିଲେ। / An imagined learner begins a new activity at a comfortable pace; the scene is invented, not a traditional birthday practice.
entries.cultural_context: No gender, initiation custom or medical threshold supplied. Age sense2 is distinct from year-number sense3 and its Malika vachana.

entries.odia: ଆମ୍ୱ ଗଛରେ ଆମ୍ୱ ନାହିଁ ଫୋପାଡ଼ କାହିଁକି ମାରୁ? ମୋ ଅଣ୍ଟାରେ ତ ପଇସା ନାହିଁ ଆଖି କାହିଁ ପାଇଁ ଠାରୁ?
entries.title: Why signal when nothing is there?
entries.literal_meaning: There are no mangoes on the mango tree; why throw a stick? I have no money at my waist; why signal with your eyes?
entries.explanation: The dictionary defines the thrown stick as one used to knock fruit down. Two questions pair an empty tree with a speaker who says they have no money. Our reading hears a challenge to an expectation without its object. The eye signal’s purpose and the relationship remain unstated; neither a bargain nor flirtation is established.
entries.meaning_odia: ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଫଳ ଝଡ଼ାଇବାକୁ ଫିଙ୍ଗାଯାଉଥିବା କାଠିର ଅର୍ଥ ଅଛି। ଦୁଇ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନରେ ଫଳ ନଥିବା ଗଛ ସହ ପଇସା ନଥିବା କହୁଥିବା ବକ୍ତା ଯୋଡ଼ିହୁଅନ୍ତି। ଆମ ପାଠରେ ଆଶା କରାଯାଉଥିବା ଜିନିଷଟି ନଥିଲେ ସେ ଆଶାକୁ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ କରାଯାଏ। ଆଖିଠାରର ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ ଓ ସମ୍ପର୍କ ଅକୁହା; ବେପାର ବା ପ୍ରଣୟ ନିଶ୍ଚିତ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: Two questions challenge an expectation; the eye signal’s meaning stays open.
entries.odia_summary: ଦୁଇ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ଆଶାକୁ ଆହ୍ୱାନ କରେ; ଆଖିଠାରର ଅର୍ଥ ଅକୁହା।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ଧାର ମାଗିବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଜଣେ ବନ୍ଧୁ ଅନ୍ୟଜଣଙ୍କ ପାଖରେ ସେହି ବହି ଅଛି କି ପଚାରିଲେ। / An imagined reader checks whether a friend owns a book before asking to borrow it. This application is invented.
entries.cultural_context: Exact ଫୋପାଡ଼ differs from headword ଫୋପଡ଼. Preceding Brajanath Samarataringa verse is separate, not this saying’s authorship.

entries.odia: ଆଳୁ ପତର, କି ସାରୁ ପତର, ସେ କି ହୋଇବ ପାନ? ପଛରେ ଯାହାକୁ ଭାରିଯା କରିବ, ସେ କି ଜାଣିବ ମନ?
entries.title: Leaves and understanding
entries.literal_meaning: An alu leaf or a saru leaf—will it become betel? Will the woman you later take as wife know your mind?
entries.explanation: The source places this comparison under marrying a woman. Its questions move from unlike leaves to doubt about a later wife’s understanding. Our critical reading asks why understanding should be ruled out beforehand. The line supplies no particular marriage history, earlier partner or cause; its doubt is not a fact about women or later marriages.
entries.meaning_odia: ଉତ୍ସରେ ଏହି ତୁଳନା ବିବାହ କରିବା ଅର୍ଥ ତଳେ ଅଛି। ଭିନ୍ନ ପତ୍ରରୁ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନଟି ପଛରେ ବିବାହ କରିବା ସ୍ତ୍ରୀ ମନ ବୁଝିବେ କି ନାହିଁ, ସେ ସନ୍ଦେହକୁ ଯାଏ। ଆମ ସମାଲୋଚନାମୂଳକ ପାଠ ପଚାରେ, ବୁଝାମଣାର ସମ୍ଭାବନାକୁ ଆଗରୁ କାହିଁକି ନାକଚ କରିବା? ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ବିବାହ ଇତିହାସ, ପୂର୍ବ ସାଥୀ ବା କାରଣ ଉତ୍ସରେ ନାହିଁ। ଏହି ସନ୍ଦେହ ନାରୀ ବା ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ବିବାହ ବିଷୟରେ ତଥ୍ୟ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: A leaf comparison voices doubt; our response questions its assumption about understanding.
entries.odia_summary: ପତ୍ର ତୁଳନାରେ ସନ୍ଦେହ; ଆମ ପାଠ ବୁଝାମଣା ବିଷୟରେ ତାହାର ଧାରଣାକୁ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ କରେ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ଦୁଇ ଜଣ ନୂଆ ସହକର୍ମୀ ପରସ୍ପରଙ୍କ କାମର ଢଙ୍ଗ ଜାଣିବାକୁ ସମୟ ନେଲେ। / Imagined colleagues learn one another’s working habits. This alternative application is invented, not a traditional explanation.
entries.cultural_context: Leaf names retained without botanical identification. Marriage sense1 is distinct from nonmarital cohabitation sense2; no remarriage custom or inherent incapacity inferred.

entries.odia: ମନରେ ଅଛି କକରଣ,ମିଛେ ବୋଲେ ବନ୍ଧୁ ବସ ବସ
entries.title: An invitation against the feeling
entries.literal_meaning: Ill-feeling within, yet falsely saying, “Friend, sit, sit.” Provisional: exact କକରଣ is read through nearby noun sense2, not silently changed to the headword କକରଶ.
entries.explanation: The invitation repeats, but the line declares a contrary feeling within. The nearby noun definition supplies ill-feeling, not the separate bodily or fever senses. Our reading concerns words of welcome that conceal reluctance; it does not prove anyone’s hidden feelings in an actual encounter.
entries.meaning_odia: ବସିବାକୁ ବାରମ୍ବାର ଡାକ, ଅଥଚ ମନରେ ଅନ୍ୟ ଭାବ—ପଦଟି ଏହି ତଫାତ କହେ। ଉତ୍ସର କକରଣ ରୂପକୁ ପାଖରେ ଥିବା ଖରାପ ଭାବ ଅର୍ଥରେ ପଢ଼ିବା ସମ୍ଭାବ୍ୟ, ନିଶ୍ଚିତ ଶବ୍ଦସଂଶୋଧନ ନୁହେଁ। ଏହା ଜ୍ୱରର ଅର୍ଥ ନୁହେଁ। ଆମ ପାଠରେ ସ୍ୱାଗତର କଥା ଅନିଚ୍ଛାକୁ ଲୁଚାଏ; କୌଣସି ପ୍ରକୃତ ସାକ୍ଷାତରେ ମନ କଥା ଜାଣିବାର ପ୍ରମାଣ ମିଳେନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Repeated welcome contrasts with the feeling the line describes.
entries.odia_summary: ବାରମ୍ବାର ଡାକ ସହ ପଦରେ କୁହାଯାଇଥିବା ମନର ଭାବ ମେଳେନାହିଁ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ଜଣେ ବ୍ୟସ୍ତ ବନ୍ଧୁ ଅନିଚ୍ଛାରେ ଡାକିବା ବଦଳରେ ଆଉ ଦିନ ଦେଖାହେବାକୁ କହିଲେ। / An imagined friend suggests another day instead of offering an unwilling welcome. This alternative response is invented.
entries.cultural_context: One dictionary witness; exact quotation-word discrepancy remains unresolved. No medical reading or specified relationship beyond the address “friend”.
